# Rule 1 — Don’t be a dick
Treat other players and staff with basic respect. Do not harass, bully, intentionally antagonize, or target people out of character.
Do not use the server as a place to start drama, insult people, bait arguments, or make others uncomfortable. Jokes are fine, but if someone tells you to stop, stop.
This rule applies everywhere connected to the community, including in-game, adminhelps, Discord, GitHub, and other official Project Verdant spaces.
Repeated toxic behavior, even if each incident seems minor on its own, may still be treated as a rule violation.
